max_connections.describe: The maximum permitted number of simultaneous client connections. Capped at 500.

innodb_log_buffer_size.describe: The size in bytes of the buffer that InnoDB uses to write to the log files on disk.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.describe: The size in bytes of the memory area where InnoDB caches table and index data. Max ~19.6GB.

innodb_redo_log_capacity.describe: The amount of disk space occupied by redo log files. Capped at ~8GB.

binlog_group_commit_sync_delay.describe: Controls how many microseconds the binary log commit waits before synchronizing.

binlog_group_commit_sync_no_delay_count.describe: Sets the maximum number of transactions to wait for.

innodb_lock_wait_timeout.describe: The length of time in seconds an InnoDB transaction waits for a row lock.

innodb_stats_persistent_sample_pages.describe: The number of index pages to sample when estimating cardinality.

innodb_read_io_threads.describe: The number of I/O threads for read operations in InnoDB. Capped at 8 (Hardware limit).

innodb_write_io_threads.describe: The number of I/O threads for write operations in InnoDB. Capped at 8 (Hardware limit).

optimizer_search_depth.describe: The maximum depth of search performed by the query optimizer.

innodb_sort_buffer_size.describe: Specifies the size of the buffer used for sorting data during creation of an InnoDB index.

myisam_sort_buffer_size.describe: The size of the buffer that is allocated when sorting MyISAM indexes.

sort_buffer_size.describe: Each session that must perform a sort allocates a buffer of this size. Capped at 64MB per connection.

join_buffer_size.describe: Minimum size of the buffer used for plain index scans and joins. Capped at 64MB per connection.

tmp_table_size.describe: The maximum size of internal in-memory temporary tables. Capped at 512MB.

max_heap_table_size.describe: Sets the maximum size to which user-created MEMORY tables are permitted to grow. Capped at 512MB.

temptable_max_ram.describe: Maximum amount of RAM that can be occupied by the TempTable storage engine. Capped at ~10GB.

temptable_max_mmap.describe: Maximum amount of memory from memory-mapped files the TempTable engine can allocate. Capped at ~10GB.

innodb_page_cleaners.describe: The number of page cleaner threads that flush dirty pages. Capped at 8 (Hardware limit).

innodb_lru_scan_depth.describe: Influences the algorithms and heuristics for the flush operation.

innodb_max_dirty_pages_pct.describe: InnoDB tries to flush data so the percentage of dirty pages does not exceed this value.

innodb_io_capacity.describe: Sets an upper limit on the I/O activity performed by InnoDB background tasks.

innodb_io_capacity_max.describe: If flushing activity falls behind, InnoDB can flush more aggressively.

innodb_flush_log_at_timeout.describe: Write and flush the logs every N seconds.

innodb_purge_threads.describe: The number of background threads devoted to the InnoDB purge operation. Capped at 8 (Hardware limit).

innodb_purge_batch_size.describe: The number of undo log pages that purge parses and processes in one batch.

innodb_flush_neighbors.describe: Specifies whether flushing a page from the buffer pool also flushes other dirty pages. (0=Off, 1=Contiguous, 2=All)
